verdict.rationale: Firebase offers serverless managed databases (Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database) that store and sync app data without servers to manage. Client apps can read, write, listen to and query data, including offline. Hands-on reports describe real-time sync across multiple clients and apps built in hours, and some note query limits such as missing count queries. Server-side access is only implied, through the Admin SDK reference and MongoDB-compatible drivers on the Enterprise edition, and provisioning comes indirectly through the CLI and MCP project and data management. missing for 10: explicit documentation of server/Admin SDK read-write against the database, explicit database-instance provisioning steps.
